tools.name: get_product
tools.description: Get the current price, availability and full description of one ProfitStore product by its product_id (from search_products, e.g. K382-19120).

tools.name: search_products
tools.description: Search the ProfitStore (profitstore.gr, Greece) product catalog. Works in Greek or English (e.g. 'ξυριστική ανδρική', 'power bank 40000'). Returns products with current price in EUR, stock status, product page url and image.
